title: SDDM Breeze theme: "Other…" (username prompt) screen has no avatar/label — "Required property realName was not initialized"
line: The login screen's "Other…" prompt shows its avatar and "Type in Username and Password" label again.
explanation: The shared user list of the lock and login screens declared realName and icon as required delegate properties. The SDDM theme's "Other…" prompt uses a one-row model with only name and icon, so the delegate could not be created ("Required property realName was not initialized") and the prompt showed neither the avatar nor its label. The delegate now reads realName and icon through model, which gives undefined for a missing role, so it falls back to the name as before.

commits.message:
lookandfeel/UserList: don't require roles every model doesn't have

The user list required realName and icon roles, but the SDDM theme's
"Other…" prompt has no realName, so its delegate failed to load and the
prompt showed no avatar or label. Read those roles through model instead.

BUG: 526857

patches.diff:
From 56d70b740fc49874e6ed150b1d2fe4664cf7c1ed Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 00:23:58 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] lookandfeel/UserList: don't require roles every model doesn't
 have
MIME-Version: 1.0
Content-Type: text/plain; charset=UTF-8
Content-Transfer-Encoding: 8bit

The user list required realName and icon roles, but the SDDM theme's
"Other…" prompt has no realName, so its delegate failed to load and the
prompt showed no avatar or label. Read those roles through model instead.

BUG: 526857
---
 lookandfeel/components/UserList.qml | 7 +++----
 1 file changed, 3 insertions(+), 4 deletions(-)

diff --git a/lookandfeel/components/UserList.qml b/lookandfeel/components/UserList.qml
index 64f51da18d..587cea635f 100644
--- a/lookandfeel/components/UserList.qml
+++ b/lookandfeel/components/UserList.qml
@@ -57,16 +57,15 @@ ListView {
     delegate: UserDelegate {
         id: userDelegate
         required property int index
-        required property string icon
-        required property string realName
+        // Not every model has every role (see above), so read them through model
         required property var model
-        avatarPath: icon || ""
+        avatarPath: model.icon || ""
         iconSource: model.iconName || "user-identity"
         fontSize: view.fontSize
         needsPassword: model.needsPassword !== undefined ? model.needsPassword : true
 
         name: {
-            const displayName = realName || model.name
+            const displayName = model.realName || model.name
 
             if (model.vtNumber === undefined || model.vtNumber < 0) {
                 return displayName
-- 
2.53.0

media.caption: Pure master, after clicking "Other…": only the Username/Password fields, no avatar and no label
With the fix, same step: avatar and "Type in Username and Password" label are shown

review.text: Correct and minimal: the delegate required realName/icon roles that the SDDM "Other…" one-row model doesn't have; reading them through the required model property is the standard Qt way for optional roles and fixes every such model rather than patching the theme's ListElement. Verified in a QML harness (no real SDDM greeter possible on Qt 6.12) plus the lock screen, which is acceptable here.
